newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 57 Kurdish rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 57 Kurdish rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish troops killed 57 Kurdish guerrillas over the past two days, including 47 who were preparing to cross into Turkey from northern Iraq, security officials said on Saturday.

The emergency rule governor's office said in a statement that 47 guerrillas from the separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed on the Iraqi border to the south of Turkey's Hakkari province as the rebels were preparing to cross into Turkey.
One member of the Turkish security forces was killed after stepping on a mine.
Eight PKK guerrillas were killed in Bingol province and two in Sirnak, the security officials said.
Turkish forces have launched several attacks on PKK guerrillas and their bases in northern Iraq in recent years.
More than 21,000 people have been killed in the 12-year struggle between the security forces and the PKK which is fighting for autonomy or independence in Turkey's mainly Kurdish southeast.
